performance_vs_target.metric: PGA 42 dB, input CM 1.75 V: DC operating point. ngspice gmin/source homotopies do NOT converge on this netlist (seed = pseudo-transient); proof of a DC solution = plain Newton re-solve from a .nodeset of the seed (no homotopy, no fallback, <= 10 mV from the seed on the signal nodes); latch search = transients (uic) from 4 extreme initial states (CM 0.3 / 3.0 V, +-1 V DM on every stage output and OTA first-stage node) that must settle to the same state
performance_vs_target.target: Newton-verified DC solution, unique across the 4 starts (+-10 mV), output CM = input CM +- 50 mV
performance_vs_target.note: review fix: the fork-S row claimed plain Newton but every log showed "Transient op started"; bench self-test: bench-validation row (a bistable stand-in fails)

performance_vs_target.target: no latch: output CM = input CM +- 50 mV, |diff| < 0.1 V, no oscillation

performance_vs_target.metric: stability, every validator-allowed combination: kick (20 mV, 10 ns) + held +100 mV input-CM step transient at SKEWED corners (MOS and poly-R/MIM corners independent, poly sheet +-25 %: design-assumptions.md); every stage DM and CM (s1, bp1, lp1, bp2, co) residual at 5-6 us. Worst cases by construction: lowest cap code (highest integrator frequency, lowest OTA feedback factor) at the highest allowed Q (validator: cap code <= 1 requires qt >= 6; qt 0 also run), every coarse PGA state (0/21/42 dB); cap codes 2/4/16 at qt 0 and 15; cap code 127 at PGA -6 dB (highest feedback factor)
performance_vs_target.target: every residual < 50 uV or decaying (no sustained / growing oscillation)
performance_vs_target.note: review fix (scratch/review-bbf): the fork-S design oscillated at ss MOS / fast R-MIM, cap code 0, qt 12 (2.47 V pp, 31 MHz). AC phase-sign screen over the full cap x Q x PGA grid: scratch/rf-bbf-u/gridx3.out
